rationale.text: The page is served as application/xhtml+xml, where attribute names are case-sensitive, and a div carries an attribute named ALIGN in capitals. The methodology lists align; whether an attribute spelt ALIGN, which the browser does not treat as align, is the listed attribute is not settled by the text. The custom check answers cannot_tell on such a case variant (step 2); only the record supports this branch. The finding is needs_review at both levels: not_enabled at fail_only, cannot_tell at full.
